unit.why: Kabbalistic kavvanot for immersion in the mikveh, attributed to R. Menahem Nahum of Chernobyl, followed by a quotation from Peri Etz Hayyim and the Zohar on two Sabbath-eve immersions; no narrative events.
unit.boundary_note: Continues a series of copied mikveh kavvanot; the previous division ends a similar excerpt from Divrei Shmuel, and the next begins a Keter Shem Tov excerpt on the Besht and immersion.
